digest.component_or_area: completion-verifier, plan-review gate, acceptance criteria metadata
propositions: The tag `[operator-attested]` must be renamed to `[non-codebase]` to better reflect that evidence lives outside the codebase rather than who attests it
The old spelling must remain as an undocumented compatibility alias to avoid silently reclassifying 827 existing immutable event-sourced tickets
The canonical regex matcher must accept both spellings case-insensitively using a non-capturing alternation to preserve findall() arity
Reader sites must be widened before emitter sites to ensure legacy persisted verdicts with `kind: "operator-attested"` continue rendering identically to new `kind: "non-codebase"` verdicts

The `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` activation trigger and packaged registry classification vocabulary must be widened so `[non-codebase]` criteria fire the provenance guard and match classification rules
Author-facing guidance and all documented surfaces must emit only `[non-codebase]`; `[operator-attested]` must not appear in any public documentation
